pre_link_regressions.scope: Pre-link compiler checkpoint; exact c3ab0741b linked execution is recorded separately above.

scope: Ordinary canonical interactive source compiled to original and decoded artifacts; private selected Bool/U64 implementation seals lower to typed native IR.
JIT and Object emission share a generic Cranelift definition; linked and JIT entries share managed admission and atomic typed publication.

Every actual compiled Cargo unit is checked for parser/codegen exclusion; reachable Mech units use local workspace source. Metadata, generated lock, Object, bytecode, generated inputs, executables and streams are retained and hashed.
Success values match complete ordinary resident and JIT outputs on original and decoded artifacts. Native finite-denial oracles compare with the JIT native work policy.
limitations: Bool/U64 straight-line scalar graphs only; no I64/F64, collections, Match/FSM/Activation, resources or capability I/O qualification.
These are correctness and linking checks, not full benchmark workload runs or measurements.
No secure/trusted full-program timing equivalence is established.
